system.description:
Theology is the lore of the queen of the sciences: the study of God's will in all things, combining historical scholarship with logic and a measure of artistic expression. It does not by itself make a character articulate, but it provides the information necessary for effective persuasion.

For medieval people this is not a matter of personal conviction but of knowable truths open to reasoned analysis. Since nothing mortal or physical lies outside God's commandments, Theology is crucial to evaluating political, economic and social disputes.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
